## Company Profile
UAB ASMI is a transport company established in 2012, specializing in local transport services in Kaunas County, Lithuania. The company focuses on providing reliable and timely transport solutions for various types of cargo.

## Core Services

### 1. [Spaudos pervežimas](https://asmi.lt/lt/paslaugos) (Press Transport)
- Distribution of newspapers and magazines to shopping centers throughout Kaunas County
- Reliable and timely delivery ensuring publications reach retail locations on time
- Specialized handling of print materials

### 2. [Gėrimų ir maisto produktų pervežimas](https://asmi.lt/lt/paslaugos) (Beverage and Food Product Transport)
- Transport and distribution of beverages and food products (without temperature control)
- Collaboration with shopping centers and distributors in Kaunas County
- Flexible scheduling to meet client needs

### 3. [Krovinių pervežimas Kauno apskrityje](https://asmi.lt/lt/paslaugos) (Cargo Transport in Kaunas County)
- General cargo transport services
- Flexible and reliable transport for various types of cargo
- Optimized routes for efficient delivery

## Geographic Focus
- Primary service area: Kaunas County, Lithuania
- Stable, planned routes optimized for efficiency
- Focus on one geographical zone for better service quality

## Fleet
- Cargo vans (krovininiai mikroautobusai)
- Medium-duty trucks (vidutinio krovumo sunkvežimiai)
- Flexible vehicle options to meet various customer needs

## Competitive Advantages
- Stable and planned routes in Kaunas County
- Over 10 years of experience in transport business
- Flexible schedule and quick response to customer needs
- Reliable and timely delivery
- Specialized knowledge of local area

## Service Philosophy
ASMI focuses on providing reliable transport services by maintaining stable routes, optimizing delivery schedules, and building long-term relationships with clients in Kaunas County. The company's approach emphasizes consistency, reliability, and flexibility in meeting customer needs.

## History
Founded in 2012 during the formative period of the local transport market, ASMI identified specific customer needs in press delivery and local transport. The company has grown from these specialized services to become a trusted transport partner in Kaunas County.

## Target Market
- Shopping centers and retail chains
- Publishers and media companies
- Food and beverage distributors
- Local businesses requiring cargo transport
- Companies needing reliable local distribution services
